Q.OrderedNuclear.AP_factors_to_PA.{u_1, u_2} {H : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
  [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] (S : Submodule ℂ H) [S.HasOrthogonalProjection] (A : H →L[ℂ] H)
  (hz : ((1 - S.starProjection).comp A).comp S.starProjection = 0) (u v : κ → H)
  (hAP : ∀ (x : H), HasSum (fun j => ⟪u j, x⟫_ℂ • v j) ((A.comp (1 - S.starProjection)) x)) (x : H) :
  HasSum (fun j => ⟪u j, x⟫_ℂ • (v j - S.starProjection (v j))) (((1 - S.starProjection).comp A) x)
'Q.OrderedNuclear.AP_factors_to_PA' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
Q.FullSourceCutoff.both_tests_PA_physical_limit_of_AP.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [LocallyCompactSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [SecondCountableTopology (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K))
  [addHaar.IsAddHaarMeasure] [addHaar.Regular] [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [SFinite mu] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu]
  (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport phi) (q : Fin 2) (Lambda epsilon : ℕ → ℝ)
  (hLambda : Filter.Tendsto Lambda Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hprod : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => epsilon n * Lambda n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (rho : ℕ → MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℝ) (hm : ∀ (n : ℕ), Measurable (rho n))
  (hb : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), 0 ≤ rho n x ∧ rho n x ≤ 1)
  (hp :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
      (Lambda n)⁻¹ + epsilon n ≤ Real.exp (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x) →
        Real.exp (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x) ≤ Lambda n - epsilon n → rho n x = 1)
  (u v : ℕ → ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) (hcost : Summable fun j => ‖u j‖ * ‖v j‖)
  (hAP :
    ∀ (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
      HasSum (fun j => ⟪u j, F⟫_ℂ • v j)
        (((PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯).comp
            (1 - (JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s).starProjection))
          F)) :
  have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯;
  let S := JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
  have P := 1 - S.starProjection;
  (∀ (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)), HasSum (fun j => ⟪u j, F⟫_ℂ • (v j - S.starProjection (v j))) ((P.comp A) F)) ∧
    (Summable fun j => ‖u j‖ * ‖v j - S.starProjection (v j)‖) ∧
      ∑' (j : ℕ), ‖u j‖ * ‖v j - S.starProjection (v j)‖ ≤ ∑' (j : ℕ), ‖u j‖ * ‖v j‖ ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((P.comp A).comp (KPhysicalMask.realMaskCLM mu (rho n) ⋯ ⋯)))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (Masullo.TraceClass.trace (P.comp A)))
